payload.body_you:
Your work becomes more visible, and so does the way you handle responsibility. The deadline. The title. The people depending on your decision. The mistake that now reaches beyond your own desk. Saturn moving through your 10th house changes the question from whether you can do the work to whether people can trust what happens when the work is yours.

Document your results. Fix the part of the process that only works when you are overextended. Take responsibility for what belongs to you, but stop carrying a larger role indefinitely without discussing title, pay, or authority. Being capable does not mean your labor should remain unofficial.
